title: Spokes with broken discovery cannot self-heal — manual bootstrap required for first teaching
signal: A spoke with broken wakeup Step 5 (wrong path or silent fail) loads no teachings during wakeup. Telling it 'accept your teachings' fails — it has an empty queue and no context. Bootstrap pattern: explicitly direct the spoke to the hub path: 'Your hub path is {hub_path}. Go to {hub_path}/teachings_repo/framework/current/ and list all .teaching files not in your WAI-Spoke/seed/ingest/processed/. Apply skill-wai-wakeup-discovery-fix-v1.md.teaching first.' After that first fix is applied, subsequent wakeups auto-discover correctly.
rationale: Self-healing via the teaching distribution system requires the distribution system to work. The first fix must be manually bootstrapped. This is a known chicken-and-egg: the fix teaching cannot deliver itself through a broken mechanism. Document and communicate the manual bootstrap pattern.
bootstrap_phrase: Your hub path is {hub_path}. Go to {hub_path}/teachings_repo/framework/current/ and list all .teaching files not already in your WAI-Spoke/seed/ingest/processed/. Apply skill-wai-wakeup-discovery-fix-v1.md.teaching first.
